A_global.reference: Authored unity operational load factor. This is an input applied to operation phases; the actual lifetime availability is reported from Timeline.ft[-1] / Timeline.plant_life.

I_p.reference: Authored 19.2 MA converted to the pinned LifeCycle API unit amperes; verification input only.

blk_1_dpa.reference: Authored verification threshold = 2.62886597938144 dpa/FPY × 2.53059542779396 FPY; this is an explicitly authored mapped schedule, not measured damage or FARIS fluence equivalence.

blk_2_dpa.reference: Authored verification threshold = 2.62886597938144 dpa/FPY × 2.53059542779396 FPY; this is an explicitly authored mapped schedule, not measured damage or FARIS fluence equivalence.

blk_dmg.reference: Authored verification mapping = 10.2 dpa/FPY × 525 MW / 2037 MW = 2.62886597938144 dpa/FPY. It enables the two limits to encode the same authored campaign interval; not measured or physically validated.

bmd.reference: Authored 60 calendar days converted to the pinned LifeCycleParams internal seconds field (5,184,000 s).

div_dmg.reference: Authored 1 dpa/FPY solely for bluemira 2.14.0 zero-duration compatibility phases; not a physical divertor damage rate.

div_dpa.reference: Authored 1.01223817111758 dpa (0.4 blanket interval at the artificial 1 dpa/FPY compatibility rate). This forces defined native LifeCycle phase counters; dmd=0 s, not a physical divertor life.

dmd.reference: Authored zero-second divertor maintenance compatibility input; divertor phases are outside the matched downtime scope.

n_DD_reactions.reference: Authored zero DD reaction rate for this controlled verification config.

n_DT_reactions.reference: Authored verification reaction rate for 525 MW fusion (17.6 MeV per D-T reaction); same nominal fusion power as the controlled FARIS scenario; not a measured plasma.

s_ramp_down.reference: Authored very high ramp rate so the native pulse ramp duration is negligible; not a design or measured limit.

s_ramp_up.reference: Authored very high ramp rate so the native pulse ramp duration is negligible; not a design or measured limit.

t_cs_recharge.reference: Authored zero to disable inter-pulse recharge downtime in the deterministic verification control.

t_pulse.reference: Authored 5,633 s repeated pulse setting for the controlled LifeCycle timeline; same period as PROCESS, not a plant operating claim.

t_pumpdown.reference: Authored zero to disable inter-pulse pumpdown downtime in the deterministic verification control.

tf_fluence.reference: Authored high sentinel to keep divertor, vessel and TF limits outside this blanket-only verification scope; not a material limit.

vv_dpa.reference: Authored high sentinel to keep divertor, vessel and TF limits outside this blanket-only verification scope; not a material limit.
